content.rendered:
Sherwood School District Vision

We strive to create the best educational experience for all students and families by: 

  • Valuing individuals, their perspectives and experiences 
  • Providing equitable educational experiences
  • Creating welcoming and inclusive environments
  • Collaborating with students, families and staff to ensure a wide range of voices are represented
